# mangos-extractor vessel list: <mapId> <displayId>   # name (entry N)
#
# Each line gives one vessel map the id of the hull model to bake into it. Map ids
# below 1000000 are the client's own Transport<entry> rows; the rest are minted by
# the server for hulls Blizzard shipped no map for (VESSEL_MAP_BASE + entry).
#
# DELIBERATELY EMPTY. The list is generated by joining the world database's
# `transports` table against Map.dbc, and neither a 5.4.8 Map.dbc nor a four_world
# database has been read for it. A list copied from a sibling core would name
# Cataclysm display ids against Mists map rows -- every line plausible, every line
# unverified -- so the baker is given nothing rather than something invented.
#
# Nothing in this server reads a vessel map yet either: TransportMap is not part of
# 04. When it lands, regenerate this from four_world.transports and a 5.4.8 Map.dbc.
